task_description: Implement immersive animation overhaul including Barba.js page transitions, timed landing sequence, globe flora/fauna system, 3D hover animations, parallax storytelling, smooth navigation theming, and spring physics throughout the site.

verification.summary: npm run build passes cleanly. No test framework exists - validation is build-only. All 39 modules transform correctly. Only warning is pre-existing Three.js chunk size (587kB).

review_fixes.findings: Fixed orphaned GSAP ticker callback by storing callback reference in module-level variable and calling gsap.ticker.remove() before lenis.destroy(). Fixed species page blank on Barba navigation by adding data-barba-prevent=self to species card links, adding setupSpeciesCardClicks() for zoom animation before full-page navigation, and changing globe navigation handler to use window.location.href instead of barba.go().
